messages:
anya: Heads-up — I sketched a draft for a per-route KPI dashboard that can help us tie kernel selection + batching + KV hit behavior to p50/p95/p99 token latency and error spikes. Wanted to get quick feedback before I open a proper ticket.

sam: Nice. Can you paste the main panels you imagine? Also call out which metrics we already emit vs. what needs new instrumentation.

anya: Sure — high level panels: 1) p50/p95/p99 token-latency (prefix vs generation) per route 2) throughput (tokens/sec + req/sec) 3) error rate & top error types 4) kernel attribution heatmap (route x kernel: percent tokens served) 5) batching efficiency (mean batch size, tail batch size, dropped-batches) 6) KV cache hit-rate + avg warmup penalty 7) recent profiling snippets (hot kernels & CPU/GPU time)

maria: +1. For instrumentation: we already emit per-request: route, model_variant, kernel_name, tokens_generated, request_latency_ms, error_code. We don't currently export token-level breakdowns (prefix vs gen) as separate metrics — that needs a small change in runtime.

kevin: For kernel attribution heatmap, we should be careful: some requests span multiple kernels (e.g., kv-prefetch + attn). Proposed metric: emit kernel_token_ms for each kernel name as a histogram sample per request, and also kernel_token_count. That lets us approximate percent time and percent tokens per kernel by aggregating.

sam: That sounds right. Also we need a way to surface batching heuristics — specifically number of concurrent sequences in each compute batch and whether the kernel fallback happened. Maybe add tags: batch_size, batch_latency_ms, kernel_fallback=true/false.

perf-bot: profile-summary: route=chat-frontend | last-1h p99_token_latency=124.6ms | kv_hit_rate=0.72 | top-kernel=fast-attn-v2 (42% tokens) | avg_batch=3.1 | fallback_rate=0.8%

anya: perf-bot output is useful — shows a real regression pattern. In the 2 recent regressions I profiled, p99 went up when fast-attn-v2 started falling back to attn_pytorch on long sequences; fallback path added ~35ms per token at p99.

maria: Do we have a reproducible profile? If so, add it to the thread with a sample trace. Even a small flamegraph snippet helps.

nate: I can grab one. Quick note: KV warmup penalty is hiding in our current token-latency metric because warmup blocks a bunch of early tokens. We should show token-latency CDFs stratified by kv_hit=yes/no. That will immediately highlight routes that suffer from cold-KV.

kevin: UX suggestion: add an interactive selector in the Console route card to toggle kernel-attribution stacking vs kernel-latency waterfall. Also allow switching sample windows (last 15m/1h/24h) and sampling rate (1%/10%/100%) so we don't explode ingest costs.

anya: Action items I propose: 1) eng-runtime: add token-level prefix/gen tagging + kernel_token_ms + kernel_token_count (owner: nate) 2) telemetry: add batch-level labels (batch_size, fallback) and kv_hit boolean (owner: kevin) 3) perf team: produce 2 flamegraphs and attach to dashboard onboarding doc (owner: maria) 4) devex: design route card layout with p50/p95/p99 + kernel attribution mini-heatmap (owner: devex — will ping separately)

sam: Sounds good. Nate — can you estimate the runtime change to emit kernel_token_ms as histogram? Rough ETA?

nate: I can do a minimal push to emit kernel_token_count and kernel_token_ms histogram with ~2 days of work including tests. I’ll try to add a low-overhead path (only when telemetry sampling flag enabled).

maria: Once we have the histograms, we can roll up p50/p95/p99 per-route by kernel and compute the waterfall. Also recommend a sanity check dashboard that compares aggregated kernel_token_ms against request-level token latency to ensure we aren’t double-counting.

kevin: I'll prototype the dashboard panels in Grafana first and then we can port to Console widgets. Will mock a kernel-heatmap and batching scatter.

anya: Great — can folks react with :thumbsup: if they agree with the action items and owners? I’ll create the GH issue after.

sam: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

nate: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

perf-bot: note: added trace sample link to the ticket when it's created — /traces/2109876600

anya: Thanks everyone — I’ll open the ticket and add the dashboard mock. If anyone wants to pair on the instrumentation, ping me in threads.
